ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A decrease in carpenter ants would affect which animal in the food web?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows the label “Carpenter ant” near the bottom center, next to an ant image. Directly above it is the “Pileated woodpecker” image and label. A blue arrow is connected from the carpenter ant upward toward the pileated woodpecker. Reasoning: In a food web, an arrow from a food source or prey to an animal indicates that the animal depends on that organism for food. Therefore, if carpenter ants decreased, the animal directly affected would be the pileated woodpecker.
